key_insight: ComputeWise finds that research agents spend only 52% of GPU time on necessary work, while a prompting-and-code harness removes over 80% of extra time to the answer.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing useful GPU work—not just utilization—can reduce wasted compute in autonomous AI research.
method: Benchmark research tasks with a simulated GPU that replays recorded runs.
Measure necessary work, unnecessary work, and idle GPU time.
Combine prompting with deterministic code to reduce waste.
evidence_signal: Hundreds of simulated experiments showed a baseline split of 52% necessary work, 22% unnecessary work, and 26% idle time; the harness reduced extra time by over 80% across five models.
watch_item: Results rely on replay-based GPU simulation; savings should be validated on real hardware and broader workloads.
paper_title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
